capture_scope: Native services plus actual CLI/MCP; expiry uses controlled monotonic time. Physical artist acceptance is separate.

path.description: Absolute destination path. Existing files are never replaced.

dimensions.description: Full output raster size, before any region extraction.

time.description: Exact output-relative time in the registered output's half-open duration.

FrameRegion.description: Pixel rectangle in the full output raster; it does not change camera framing.

ProjectGuard.description: Project-wide operations deliberately have no document-edit scope.

Slot.description: Explicit presence distinguishes deleting a property from writing JSON null.

Time.description: Normalized rational seconds. Denominators are positive; arithmetic never wraps.
